title: Petal Pilot
theme: A tiny seed pod drifts on gentle breezes through a quiet sky garden, blooming into paper flowers that catch the light and invite friendly sky-moths to rest
mechanics: Drift with mouse/tap to guide the seed pod
Bloom into a flower by collecting light petals
Attract friendly sky-moths that pollinate new seeds
Manage a small bounded garden with discrete pickups and one terminal goal

controls.action: Move the seed pod toward the cursor
